kicker: Heze Orbital Yard · unit of account
sub: The yard quotes in it, the docket sums in it, and a hull is released against it. It is a unit of account for the files in this project — not a chain, not a contract, and not for sale.

grid.p: Fixed by definition. Nothing in these files issues more.
Ten hulls, priced from their own bills of materials.
No transfer exists. The docket is a piece of paper.

lede: Six slides. What the number is, what stands behind it, how a hull is drawn from an address, what the yard charges, and — at the end, in full — what this is not.
text: The opening slide: HEZE as a unit of account, fixed supply, no settlement, not for sale.
